bag_end.name: Bag End
bag_end.description: You stand in the cozy hobbit-hole of Bag End, the most comfortable dwelling in all the Shire. Round windows set deep in the hillside let in cheerful sunlight that dances across polished wooden floors. The smell of fine pipeweed lingers in the air, mingling with the scent of fresh bread from the kitchen.
